name: body_rich_text
label: Content Area
help_text: Optional body content. Leave blank to hide the text block.
default:
Use this Content Area for the main story of the section. It supports rich text — paragraphs, headings, lists, links, and more. With Show Inset on, the inset card floats beside this copy on desktop so lines wrap around it instead of sitting in a rigid two-column layout.

Keep a short opening paragraph or two above any in-content heading so the float has room to settle. Longer body copy below is what makes wrap-under obvious in the editor and on the live page.

How the inset behaves

Inset Width controls how wide the card is at XL, Desktop, and Tablet (use Inherit to cascade). Set a breakpoint to 12 columns to stack full width. Inset Order chooses left/right when floated, and on mobile which block sits on top or on the bottom when stacked.

Inset Vertical Align (Top / Middle / Bottom) only applies while floated. Top is a classic float: text beside the card, then continuing underneath. Middle and Bottom sink the card so copy can fill above it as well; Bottom keeps the card flush with the end of this content so nothing sits under the card.

Inset Card Styles set background (Theme Color or Custom), border, radius, and inset text/link colors. Use the Headings repeater above for section titles; put supporting subheads like this one in the Content Area when you want them to participate in the float wrap.

Add enough paragraphs that the last lines clearly run full width under a Top-aligned inset (or stop beside a Bottom-aligned one). That wrap-under behavior is the point of this module — no empty sidebar column when the card is shorter than the body.

children.label: Blob style

children.name: color_1

children.name: color_2
children.label: Aurora Color 2

children.name: color_3
children.label: Aurora Color 3
children.help_text: Stamp 3 color. The percentage is that stamp’s strength (0% hides this stamp).

children.name: strength
children.label: Strength
children.help_text: Multiplies all three stamps. 50 is the default wash; 0 is off; 100 is full stamp strength.

children.name: edge_blur
children.label: Edge blur (px)
children.help_text: Gaussian blur of each hard stamp. 0 is a crisp edge. 20 softens the rim but the blob still reads as a shape. 120 dissolves it.
children.inline_help_text: 0 = hard edge. Higher = softer rim in and out.

children.name: scale
children.label: Scale (%)
children.help_text: Stamp size. 100 is default. Lower is smaller; higher is larger.

children.name: blend
children.label: Blend
children.help_text: How the wash mixes with this Outer fill. Normal keeps Aurora Color honest. Overlay and Soft Light sit on photos. Multiply darkens (good on light Color fills); Screen lightens.

children.name: motion
children.label: Motion
children.help_text: Slow drift of the stamps. On when Aurora is enabled. Turn off for a still wash. Live pages respect prefers-reduced-motion and stay still.

children.name: duration
children.label: Duration
children.help_text: How long one drift cycle takes. This is duration, not velocity: 8 seconds is faster; 30 seconds is slower.
children.inline_help_text: Seconds per cycle. Lower is faster.

children.name: custom_color
children.label: Custom Color

children.name: animation
children.label: Animation

children.name: appear_duration
children.label: Appear duration (seconds)

children.name: twinkle_speed
children.label: Twinkle speed
children.help_text: How often a new set fades off. Each set fades out, stays off for twice this interval (Slow/Medium = 2s, Fast = 1.5s), then fades back in. The next set starts while the last set is still off, so some squares stay dark.

children.name: custom_h_edge

children.name: custom_h_offset
children.label: Horiz Offset

children.name: custom_h_unit

children.name: custom_v_edge
children.label: Custom Vertical Edge

children.name: custom_v_offset
children.label: Vert Offset
children.help_text: Vertical offset from the selected edge.

children.name: custom_v_unit
children.label: Vert Unit
children.help_text: Unit used for the vertical offset.

children.name: scale
children.label: Scale (%)
children.help_text: Size of the SVG relative to the Outer band. 100% fits the graphic inside the band without stretching. Use this if you need it larger or smaller after Position.

children.name: opacity
children.label: Opacity (%)
children.help_text: Transparency of the whole overlay layer. 100% is fully visible. Does not change the colors inside the SVG. Appear and twinkle still run on top of this.

children.name: disable

children.help_text: Hide the overlay at specific viewports. Each toggle is independent — turning off MD does not turn off SM. All off by default so the overlay shows at every size. Useful when you also hide the Outer image at that size.

children.name: lg

children.name: md

children.help_text: Hide the overlay on tablet only. Does not hide other sizes — turn those off separately if you want them hidden too.

children.name: sm
children.label: SM

children.name: blur

children.name: fill

children.name: saturate
children.label: Glass Saturate (%)

children.name: border

children.name: density

children.name: scale

children.label: Grain Background
children.help_text: Tint behind the speckle. Transparent by default so the module background shows through behind the footer panel.

children.name: grain_color
children.label: Grain Color
children.help_text: Speckle hue and strength. The color percentage is how visible the grain is (100% = strongest; 0% = none).

children.name: blend
children.label: Grain Blend
children.help_text: How the speckle mixes with the layer below. Normal keeps Grain Color honest. Overlay and Soft Light are film-on-photo. Multiply only darkens; Screen only lightens.

children.name: density
children.label: Grain Density
children.help_text: How many specks per area. Speckle size stays with Grain Scale. Sparse = gappier; Dense = packed.

children.name: scale
children.label: Grain Scale (%)
children.help_text: Speckle size. 100 is default. Lower = finer (smaller specks); higher = coarser (larger specks).

children.name: inner_pattern
children.label: Pattern
children.help_text: Repeating overlay over the module background visible behind the footer panel. Does not add a photo. Style is Dots, Grid, Lines (four orientations), or Custom SVG. Pattern Color percentage is strength. Pattern Background is an optional tint.
children.inline_help_text: Custom SVG code is at the bottom of the Content tab: Footer Panel Pattern — Custom SVG Code.

children.name: style
children.label: Pattern Style
children.help_text: Repeating overlay. Lines include horizontal, vertical, and both diagonals. Custom SVG uses Color Mode (SVG hues vs Pattern Color) and Pattern Size (Repeat vs Fit overlay).
children.inline_help_text: Custom SVG code is at the bottom of the Content tab: Footer Panel Pattern — Custom SVG Code.
choices: Lines — Top left to bottom right
Lines — Bottom left to top right

children.name: color_mode
children.label: Pattern Color Mode
children.help_text: Override paints the SVG silhouette with Pattern Color (hues in the markup are ignored). Use SVG colors keeps fills and gradients from the markup; Pattern Opacity is strength.

children.name: size_mode
children.label: Pattern Size
children.help_text: Always anchored middle center. Repeat tiles a 256px-wide copy from the center (Scale changes tile size). Fit overlay places one copy from the center (Scale zooms; 100% = inner width).

children.name: background
children.label: Pattern Background
children.help_text: Tint behind the pattern. Transparent by default so the module background shows through behind the footer panel.

children.name: pattern_color
children.label: Pattern Color
children.help_text: Pattern hue and strength. The color percentage is how visible the pattern is (100% = strongest; 0% = none). Start lower than Grain — a grid at 85% is very strong. Hidden when Custom SVG uses SVG colors.

children.name: opacity
children.label: Pattern Opacity
children.help_text: How strong the SVG artwork is. Hues stay as authored. 0 = none; 100 = full ink.

children.name: blend
children.label: Pattern Blend
children.help_text: How the pattern mixes with the layer below. Normal keeps Pattern Color honest. Overlay and Soft Light are film-on-photo. Multiply only darkens; Screen only lightens.

children.name: scale
children.label: Pattern Scale (%)
children.help_text: Repeat: tile size (lower = tighter). Fit overlay: zoom of the one copy (100% = inner width).

children.name: panel_border_override
children.label: Override Footer Panel Border
children.help_text: When on, use the border style, weight, color, and radius below on the footer panel. When off, the panel has no custom border or radius (Effect glass edge still applies when Background is Effect).

children.name: panel_border_style
children.label: Footer Panel Border Style
children.help_text: Border style when Override Footer Panel Border is on. Use None to remove the stroke while keeping custom radius available.

children.name: panel_border_width
children.label: Footer Panel Border Weight (px)
children.help_text: Border weight when Override Footer Panel Border is on.

children.name: panel_border_color
children.label: Footer Panel Border Color
children.help_text: Border color and opacity when Override Footer Panel Border is on.

children.name: panel_border_radius
children.label: Footer Panel Border Radius (px)
children.help_text: Corner radius for the footer panel when Override Footer Panel Border is on.

children.name: max_panel_width
children.label: Max Footer Panel Width
children.help_text: Caps the footer panel width. Full Width matches the module inner max width. Narrower widths use Footer Text Alignment below.

children.name: max_panel_width_custom
children.label: Max Footer Panel Width (px)
children.help_text: Custom max width when Custom is selected above.

children.name: text_align
children.label: Footer Text Alignment (Desktop)
children.help_text: Horizontal alignment for Footer Content and its headings when Align is Auto. Tablet and Mobile can override below.

children.name: override_md_text_align
children.label: Override Footer Text Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different Footer Panel text alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: text_align_md
children.label: Footer Text Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Text alignment for the Footer Panel when Override Footer Text Alignment (Tablet) is enabled.

children.name: override_sm_text_align
children.label: Override Footer Text Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different Footer Panel text alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: text_align_sm
children.label: Footer Text Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Text alignment for the Footer Panel when Override Footer Text Alignment (Mobile) is enabled.

children.name: spacing
children.label: Footer Panel Spacing (Desktop)
children.help_text: Margin and padding for the complete Footer Panel at this breakpoint. Tablet and Mobile can override when their overrides are enabled.

children.name: override_md_spacing
children.label: Override Footer Panel Spacing (Tablet)
children.help_text: Enable to set custom margin and padding for the Footer Panel at this breakpoint.

children.name: spacing_md
children.label: Footer Panel Spacing (Tablet)
children.help_text: Margin and padding for the Footer Panel when Override Footer Panel Spacing (Tablet) is enabled.

children.name: override_sm_spacing
children.label: Override Footer Panel Spacing (Mobile)
children.help_text: Enable to set custom margin and padding for the Footer Panel at this breakpoint.

children.name: spacing_sm
children.label: Footer Panel Spacing (Mobile)
children.help_text: Margin and padding for the Footer Panel when Override Footer Panel Spacing (Mobile) is enabled.

children.name: inset_width_setting
children.label: Inset Width
children.help_text: Controls the width of the inset card when floated. Body text fills the remaining space and wraps under a short inset. 12 columns = stacked full width.

children.name: inset_cols_xl
children.label: XL Inset Width
children.help_text: Controls the inset width on XL screens. Body fills the rest. 12 = stacked.

children.name: inset_cols_lg
children.label: Desktop Inset Width
children.help_text: Controls the inset width on desktop. Select Inherit to use XL Inset Width. 12 = stacked.

children.name: inset_cols_md
children.label: Tablet Inset Width
children.help_text: Controls the inset width on tablet. Select Inherit to use Desktop Inset Width (or XL if Desktop is Inherit).

children.name: inset_settings
children.label: Inset Settings
children.help_text: Which side the inset floats on (or which edge is on top when stacked). Vertical align uses a spacer so body text can wrap above a middle/bottom inset.

children.name: xl_inset_position
children.label: XL Inset Order
children.help_text: Which side the inset floats on at XL (or on top when stacked at 12 cols).

children.name: desktop_inset_position
children.label: Desktop Inset Order
children.help_text: Select Inherit to use XL Inset Order.

children.name: tablet_inset_position
children.label: Tablet Inset Order
children.help_text: Select Inherit to use Desktop Inset Order (or XL if Desktop is Inherit).

children.name: mobile_inset_position
children.label: Mobile Inset Order
children.help_text: Which block appears on top when stacked.

children.name: inset_vertical_align
children.label: Inset Vertical Align
children.help_text: When floated: Top keeps the inset at the start of the body (classic float). Middle and Bottom offset the floated card with empty space above it inside the same float, so body text wraps above, beside, and below the card.

children.name: inset_gap
children.label: Gap Beside Inset (px)
children.help_text: Space between the inset and the body on the inner edge when floated. Outer flush edge is always 0.

children.name: inset_spacing
children.label: Inset Spacing
children.help_text: Padding inside the inset card. Outer float edge margins are forced to 0 in CSS.

children.name: inset_background_option
children.label: Inset Background
children.help_text: None, Theme Color, or Custom Color for the inset card.

children.name: inset_background_theme_color
children.label: Theme Color
children.help_text: Theme color for the inset card background.

children.name: inset_background_custom
children.label: Custom Color
children.help_text: Hex color with opacity for the inset card background.

children.name: override_inset_border_radius
children.label: Override Inset Border Radius
children.help_text: When off, use the Global Border Radius from theme settings. When on, use the custom radius below.

children.name: inset_border_radius
children.label: Inset Border Radius (px)
children.help_text: Custom corner radius for the inset card. Set to 0 for square corners.

children.name: heading_settings
children.label: Headings
children.help_text: Typography options for the heading repeater.

children.name: heading_text_wrap
children.label: Heading text wrap
children.help_text: How heading lines wrap. Auto uses browser default; Balance evens line lengths. This module defaults to Auto.

name: background_video_settings
label: Module Background Video
help_text: Set Background Option to Video in the Style tab first, then choose the video source (file, HubSpot video, or embed) and poster image here. Overlay and base color for video are in the Style tab when Video is selected.

children.name: video_source_type
children.label: Video Type
children.help_text: Choose HubSpot Video (Marketing > Video), a video from the File Manager, or an external embed (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.).

children.name: hubspot_video
children.label: HubSpot Video
children.help_text: Select a video from Marketing > Video. Requires Marketing Video in your HubSpot account.

children.name: video_file
children.label: Video from Files
children.help_text: Select a video from the File Manager. Shown as background; autoplay muted and loop. Works on all HubSpot tiers (no Video Management required).

children.name: embed_field
children.label: External Embed
children.help_text: Embed a video from YouTube, Vimeo, or other external sources. For autoplay as background, use a URL that includes autoplay and muted if supported.

children.name: poster_image
children.label: Poster Image
children.help_text: Shown before the video loads and as fallback if video fails.
